SELECT
  argMax(ul_ok, ts) AS ul_ok,
  argMax(ul_miss, ts) AS ul_miss
FROM poc_latency.pktlat_stats FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND run_id IN (${run_id:singlequote})

SELECT
  argMax(dl_ok, ts) AS dl_ok,

FROM poc_latency.pktlat_stats FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND run_id IN (${run_id:singlequote})

SELECT
  if((argMax(ul_ok,ts)+argMax(ul_miss,ts))>0,
     100.0 * argMax(ul_ok,ts) / (argMax(ul_ok,ts)+argMax(ul_miss,ts)),
     NULL) AS pct
FROM poc_latency.pktlat_stats FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND run_id IN (${run_id:singlequote})

SELECT

FROM poc_latency.pktlat_stats FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND run_id IN (${run_id:singlequote})

WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND run_id IN (${run_id:singlequote})

panels.title: Breakdown segmen (QUIC rt): core S1-U ↔ SGi

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(a.ts) AS time,
  quantile(0.5)(b.one_way_ms - a.one_way_ms) AS core_ms
FROM (SELECT * FROM poc_latency.pkt_latency FINAL) AS a
INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM poc_latency.pkt_latency FINAL) AS b
  ON a.run_id=b.run_id AND a.source=b.source AND a.proto=b.proto
 AND a.flow=b.flow AND a.dir=b.dir AND a.hash=b.hash AND a.off=b.off AND a.len=b.len
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.ts)
  AND a.dir='UL' AND a.seg='s1u' AND b.seg='sgi'
  AND a.proto='quic' AND a.source='rt'
  AND a.one_way_ms IS NOT NULL AND b.one_way_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND run_id IN (${run_id:singlequote})
  AND a.flow IN (${flow:singlequote})
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(a.ts) AS time,
  quantile(0.5)(a.one_way_ms - b.one_way_ms) AS core_ms
FROM (SELECT * FROM poc_latency.pkt_latency FINAL) AS a
INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM poc_latency.pkt_latency FINAL) AS b
  ON a.run_id=b.run_id AND a.source=b.source AND a.proto=b.proto
 AND a.flow=b.flow AND a.dir=b.dir AND a.hash=b.hash AND a.off=b.off AND a.len=b.len
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.ts)
  AND a.dir='DL' AND a.seg='s1u' AND b.seg='sgi'
  AND a.proto='quic' AND a.source='rt'
  AND a.one_way_ms IS NOT NULL AND b.one_way_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND run_id IN (${run_id:singlequote})
  AND a.flow IN (${flow:singlequote})
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: p50/p90 QUIC rt vs TCP offline, per arah dan tap
panels.description: Bukan pencocokan per paket (protokol berbeda). Angka baseline TCP vs QUIC waktu nyata, side-by-side.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  proto,
  source,
  dir,
  seg,
  count() AS n,
  round(quantile(0.5)(one_way_ms), 2) AS p50_ms,
  round(quantile(0.9)(one_way_ms), 2) AS p90_ms,
  round(quantile(0.99)(one_way_ms), 2) AS p99_ms,
  round(min(one_way_ms), 2) AS min_ms,
  round(max(one_way_ms), 2) AS max_ms
FROM poc_latency.pkt_latency FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND one_way_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    (proto='quic' AND source='rt')
    OR (proto='tcp' AND source='offline-tcp')
  )
  AND run_id IN (${run_id:singlequote})
GROUP BY proto, source, dir, seg
ORDER BY dir, seg, source
